name: granttap
description: Pair local coding agents with GrantTap and approve, answer, or steer their work from iPhone and Apple Watch.

interface.longDescription: Try now / Connect GrantTap: the agent connects this computer. You do not pair in chat. Authenticate opens granttap.com/connect. Device list, Approve, Add another device, and Reconnect stay on that page, in GrantTap plugin settings, and in the GrantTap app. The same pairing room is shared. Provider sign-in is separate.
defaultPrompt: Check whether this computer is connected to GrantTap.
